fix(camellia): stabilize login and shared session shell

Summary:
- add light/dark/system theme support and surface it in login and console
- rebuild the login screen around a primary credential flow with explicit token
  bootstrap and no hardcoded sample credentials
- unify session settings with the shared camellia session and keep the console
  interactive during background session checks

Rationale:
- the previous login page mixed credentials and token wiring in one noisy screen
  and encouraged invalid default credentials
- migrated pages were reading split session stores, which made the shell and
  user-domain routes drift out of sync
- replacing the full-shell loading swap during refresh removes the reported
  post-login flashing behavior

Tests:
- pnpm run typecheck:camellia
- pnpm run build:camellia
- pnpm run smoke:camellia:deploy
